# Service Buddy

> An MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, and Claude Desktop that turns a founder's plain-language
> request ("let people upload a photo") into real, working infrastructure on Floci, a local AWS
> emulator, and re-checks each piece for real before reporting it done.

The server (`harness/`) matches a request against a catalog of 13 capabilities (`catalog/`). The
calling agent runs the provisioning steps, and the server independently re-verifies the result
against live local infrastructure before it records anything: no agent self-report is trusted.
Replies to the founder stay in plain language. It also includes a research reference on harness
engineering (Agent = Model + Harness), in `research/`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quickstart, troubleshooting, benchmark numbers, and an engineer overview.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI coding agent connects to the MCP server, every tool, and which outputs are founder-safe.
- [Harness README](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/harness/README.md): the MCP server's architecture and how to run it.
- [Capability catalog](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/catalog/README.md): the 13 things it can set up and how each is verified.
- [Benchmark results](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/tasks/README.md): before/after numbers against a fixed six-task set, including negative findings.

## Design decisions

- [AgDR-0001: shared backend naming scope isolation](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/research/agdr/AgDR-0001-shared-backend-naming-scope-isolation.md): isolating multiple agents on one shared backend by resource ownership, not per-agent infrastructure.
- [AgDR-0002: flock-based state locking](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/research/agdr/AgDR-0002-flock-based-state-locking.md): cross-process state locking for an MCP server where every client spawns its own subprocess.
- [AgDR-0003: snapshot/restore, not clone](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/research/agdr/AgDR-0003-snapshot-restore-not-clone.md): environment snapshots save recorded state and re-verify it live on restore.
- [AgDR-0004: ownership metadata, not enforcement](https://github.com/ahmedkeewan/service-buddy/blob/main/research/agdr/AgDR-0004-multi-founder-metadata-not-enforcement.md): environment owners are recorded, not enforced.
